bio:
Dr. Zakir Hussain Parray is an academic leader, educator, researcher, author, healthcare professional, consultant, and entrepreneur specializing in Anaesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology, Allied Health Sciences, medical education, research, academic quality, and professional development.
With 8+ years of professional experience, he has progressed from clinical Operation Theatre practice to academic leadership, curriculum development, faculty training, research, accreditation, and academic consulting. He has worked with leading institutions including Government Medical College & Hospital Baramulla, Adesh Institute of Medical Sciences, Rayat Bahra University, Guru Kashi University, Brainware University, and Emversity.
His expertise includes AOTT academic leadership, competency-based education, curriculum design, faculty development, NAAC and NCAHP-aligned quality systems, research supervision, academic publishing, and institutional coordination.

Message from the Founder

My vision is to bridge education, healthcare, research, and innovation by creating meaningful opportunities for students, educators, researchers, and healthcare professionals. Through academic leadership, evidence-based education, research, and professional development, I aim to contribute to a more competent, ethical, and future-ready healthcare workforce.

“Learn continuously, lead responsibly, and create an impact that extends beyond the classroom.”
